name: issuetraceability

queries.label: linked_issues
queries.sql_text:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT issue_id) AS linked_issues
FROM (
  SELECT rl.issue_id
  FROM devlake._tool_jira_remotelinks rl
  JOIN devlake._tool_jira_issues ji
    ON ji.issue_id = rl.issue_id AND ji.connection_id = rl.connection_id
  WHERE (:hasIssueScope = 1 AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(ji.issue_key, '-', 1) IN (:projectKeys))
    AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM devlake.issues scoped_issue
    JOIN devlake.board_issues scoped_board ON scoped_board.issue_id = scoped_issue.id
    WHERE scoped_issue.issue_key = ji.issue_key
      AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(scoped_board.board_id, ':', 3), ':', -1) = ji.connection_id
      AND scoped_board.board_id LIKE 'jira:%'
    AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM JSON_TABLE(:boardScopes, '$[*]' COLUMNS (
      project_key VARCHAR(1024) PATH '$.project_key',
      project_name VARCHAR(1024) PATH '$.project_name',
      board_id VARCHAR(128) PATH '$.board_id',
      connection_id VARCHAR(128) PATH '$.connection_id'
    )) AS selected_scope
    WHERE ((selected_scope.project_key <> '' AND selected_scope.project_key COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = SUBSTRING_INDEX(scoped_issue.issue_key, '-', 1))
      OR (selected_scope.project_name <> '' AND selected_scope.project_name COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = scoped_issue.original_project))
      AND (selected_scope.board_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = '' OR selected_scope.board_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = SUBSTRING_INDEX(scoped_board.board_id, ':', -1))
      AND (selected_scope.connection_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = '' OR selected_scope.connection_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(scoped_board.board_id, ':', 3), ':', -1))
  )
  )
    AND rl.url LIKE '%github.com%/pull/%'
    AND ji.resolution_date >= FROM_UNIXTIME(:from)
    AND ji.resolution_date <= FROM_UNIXTIME(:to)
  UNION
  SELECT ji.issue_id
  FROM devlake.pull_requests pr
  JOIN devlake.repos r ON r.id = pr.base_repo_id
  JOIN devlake._tool_jira_issues ji
    ON pr.title LIKE CONCAT('%', ji.issue_key, '%')
  WHERE (:hasIssueScope = 1 AND r.name IN (:repoNames))
    AND pr.title REGEXP CONCAT('(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])', ji.issue_key, '([^0-9]|$)')
    AND (:hasIssueScope = 1 AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(ji.issue_key, '-', 1) IN (:projectKeys))
    AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM devlake.issues scoped_issue
    JOIN devlake.board_issues scoped_board ON scoped_board.issue_id = scoped_issue.id
    WHERE scoped_issue.issue_key = ji.issue_key
      AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(scoped_board.board_id, ':', 3), ':', -1) = ji.connection_id
      AND scoped_board.board_id LIKE 'jira:%'
    AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM JSON_TABLE(:boardScopes, '$[*]' COLUMNS (
      project_key VARCHAR(1024) PATH '$.project_key',
      project_name VARCHAR(1024) PATH '$.project_name',
      board_id VARCHAR(128) PATH '$.board_id',
      connection_id VARCHAR(128) PATH '$.connection_id'
    )) AS selected_scope
    WHERE ((selected_scope.project_key <> '' AND selected_scope.project_key COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = SUBSTRING_INDEX(scoped_issue.issue_key, '-', 1))
      OR (selected_scope.project_name <> '' AND selected_scope.project_name COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = scoped_issue.original_project))
      AND (selected_scope.board_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = '' OR selected_scope.board_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = SUBSTRING_INDEX(scoped_board.board_id, ':', -1))
      AND (selected_scope.connection_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = '' OR selected_scope.connection_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(scoped_board.board_id, ':', 3), ':', -1))
  )
  )
    AND ji.resolution_date >= FROM_UNIXTIME(:from)
    AND ji.resolution_date <= FROM_UNIXTIME(:to)
) combined

  JOIN devlake.repos r ON r.id = pr.base_repo_id
  WHERE (:hasIssueScope = 1 AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(ji.issue_key, '-', 1) IN (:projectKeys))

    ON pr.title LIKE CONCAT('%', ji.issue_key, '%')
  WHERE (:hasIssueScope = 1 AND r.name IN (:repoNames))

    AND (:hasIssueScope = 1 AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(ji.issue_key, '-', 1) IN (:projectKeys))

    SELECT 1 FROM devlake.issues scoped_issue
    JOIN devlake.board_issues scoped_board ON scoped_board.issue_id = scoped_issue.id
    WHERE scoped_issue.issue_key = ji.issue_key
      AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(scoped_board.board_id, ':', 3), ':', -1) = ji.connection_id
      AND scoped_board.board_id LIKE 'jira:%'
    AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM JSON_TABLE(:boardScopes, '$[*]' COLUMNS (
      project_key VARCHAR(1024) PATH '$.project_key',
      project_name VARCHAR(1024) PATH '$.project_name',
      board_id VARCHAR(128) PATH '$.board_id',
      connection_id VARCHAR(128) PATH '$.connection_id'
    )) AS selected_scope
    WHERE ((selected_scope.project_key <> '' AND selected_scope.project_key COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = SUBSTRING_INDEX(scoped_issue.issue_key, '-', 1))
      OR (selected_scope.project_name <> '' AND selected_scope.project_name COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = scoped_issue.original_project))
      AND (selected_scope.board_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = '' OR selected_scope.board_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = SUBSTRING_INDEX(scoped_board.board_id, ':', -1))
      AND (selected_scope.connection_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = '' OR selected_scope.connection_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(scoped_board.board_id, ':', 3), ':', -1))
  )
  )
    AND pr.closed_date >= FROM_UNIXTIME(:from)
    AND pr.closed_date <= FROM_UNIXTIME(:to)
    AND pr.is_draft = 0
    AND pr.author_name NOT LIKE '%[bot]%'
    AND pr.author_name NOT LIKE '%dependabot%'
    AND pr.author_name NOT LIKE '%renovate%'
    AND pr.author_name NOT LIKE '%snyk%'
    AND (:hasUserWhitelist = 0 OR pr.author_name IN (:userwhitelist))
) combined
